audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows are wrong. Packet is Ziggs, Ziggs, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen; the pages read Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Garen, Skill, Garen, and the full layer's last row is 'Ziggs siege' at 2/10 while content's win[6] already says Garen. diffRating is 7/10 against a diff token of FAV and a 53% win rate.
audit.why: whys[2] 'Level 3 Q move-speed and silence let you close and spin him down', whys[4] 'R at 6 executes Ziggs after your silence combo — he has no defense', whys[6] 'Late you delete him in any fight you reach past his Satchel escape'. The mid prose says 'From level 3 the lane flips to you'. Ziggs genuinely owns levels 1-2 and nothing after.
audit.corrected: Level 3, Level 6 and 2+ items -> Garen 6/10. Levels 1-2 stay Ziggs. diffRating 7/10 -> 4/10, and the difficulty prose restated (it also carries scraped page-footer junk, 'Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 135', which the rewrite removes).

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] gives Satchel Charge as 24s, and no page states what Decisive Strike does to Hexplosive Minefield.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12 — 20s at rank 1, not 24s. It knocks Ziggs away too but deals him no damage, which is why it is his only escape. Hexplosive Minefield does magic damage and SLOWS (16s flat cooldown), and Garen's Decisive Strike 'gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him' on cast — so the minefield cannot stop a Q-opened run-down. The page currently implies the mines zone you off even after level 3, which is the opposite of the truth and is exactly why the level-3 row was mis-scored.
audit.corrected: Quote 20s at rank 1, and state that Q purges the minefield slow so you walk through it rather than around it.

audit.why: The four spikes are placed correctly for the corrected chart: Garen's window opens at 3-5 on Satchel downtime, level 6 adds the execute on a mage with no defensive layer, first item snowballs repeated all-ins, and late he still dies to anything that reaches him. Only spikes[0] was reworded, to add the real cooldown and the slow-purge.
Both packet.suspectNames entries are false positives. "Decisive Strike's" is Garen's own Q with a possessive; 'Save Satchel Charge' uses Ziggs's real W name.

edits.before: Track Ziggs’s Satchel Charge (24s): His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 — his only escape. Hexplosive Minefield just slows, and Decisive Strike breaks slows on cast.

edits.before: Bleed HP chasing his kite. Spin into a freeze you can't reach. All-in without Q move speed up. The R buys fights, not poke — spend it like the last one in stock.
edits.after: Bleed HP chasing his kite. Walk around his minefield — Decisive Strike purges the slow, so walk straight through it. All-in without Q move speed up.

edits.before: Once you have Q-E and boots, engage on Ziggs the moment his Satchel Charge (W) is on cooldown — that's his only escape, and Decisive Strike's move-speed plus silence gets you on top of him for a full spin.
edits.after: Engage the moment Satchel Charge is down — it is 20s at rank 1 and his only escape. Decisive Strike's move speed also breaks the Hexplosive Minefield slow, so the mines do not stop the run-down.

edits.before: : Overall difficulty: 7/10. Success depends entirely on mechanical patience—hiding your silence entries and buffering your active shield correctly. Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 135
edits.after: Favourable lane — difficulty 4/10, Ziggs carry threat 8/10: he owns levels 1-2, then every Satchel Charge downtime from level 3 on is a free all-in on a squishy, immobile mage.
